title: Grateful Dead Live at Silva Hall, Hult Center on 1984-05-06
lineage: Cassette (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->  Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a well‑paced show highlighted by Black Peter and a strong Hell‑in‑a‑Bucket/Dire Wolf stretch.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clear, face‑board mix and solid transfer, making the performance easy to hear. Fans note a nicely controlled energy flow with standout moments like Jerry’s vocal on Black Peter and an elegant Hell‑in‑a‑Bucket → Dire Wolf sequence. Overall sentiment is mixed‑positive, with most reviewers enjoying the show while one finds it merely standard.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviews rate the show and recording 4/5 and comment positively on performance and sound quality; a few neutral/low ratings pull the average down slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, face‑board sound with a solid transfer; no major dropouts or muffiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe an elegant pacing and controlled energy, especially through the Hell‑in‑a‑Bucket → Dire Wolf segment; one reviewer calls the show standard with no obvious highlights.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Great vocal performance noted on Black Peter.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mention of "Bobby chomping at the bit" indicating energetic playing.
